# RAR test fixtures

Copied unchanged from the `test/files/` directory of the rarfile 4.5 source distribution
(https://pypi.org/project/rarfile/4.5/, sdist sha256 7425d0afa180f0092db903abb1526a130b36858980aad90b3694f48e41420155).
RAR archives cannot be created without WinRAR, so these small samples are used to test RAR support.

Password for `rar5-psw.rar` and `rar5-hpsw.rar`: `password`.
